verdict.rationale: The evidence never addresses model training directly. It shows only indirect privacy control: Cognee is open source and can run entirely on your own machine or stack with no account, and the CLI demo runs with no API key on a machine with no network access, so you can keep data away from third parties. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out for Cognee Cloud, documentation of how data sent to external LLM/embedding providers is handled, and documented fully local model support beyond the demo.
